implementation.name: Space Race (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 43 HDL source files (40 systemverilog, 3 verilog) alongside 4 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: 1 MRA files in the repository's releases/ directory carry a <setname>; 0 resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 0 through MAME's own cloneof relation to the parent set that survives extract/machine.json's parents-only filter, giving 0 distinct machine_id rows. 1 setname(s) did not resolve (absent-from-mame-0288: 1). Machines unmapped: the MRA's <setname>spacerace</setname> is a MiSTer-local name: it is not one of MAME 0.288's 50,097 machine shortnames, and a scan of every <description> finds no machine for Atari's 1973 Space Race, so it cannot be resolved even through MAME's cloneof relation. License: https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-SpaceRace_MiSTer/blob/master/LICENSE is the verbatim GNU GPL version 2 text, and the grant in https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Arcade-SpaceRace_MiSTer/blob/master/Arcade-SpaceRace.sv reads "either version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-2.0-or-later. hdl_language_id: 40 of 43 HDL files are systemverilog (40 systemverilog, 3 verilog), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.
